title: Trash Panda
description:
It's garbage night, and there's no human in sight! Explore neighbourhoods of Toronto as the unofficial mascot of the city: the Trash Panda.Make a Mess!As a mischievous raccoon, make the biggest mess you can knocking over trash bins lining the streets. The bigger the mess, the higher you score. Some of the trash is yummy-yummy treats giving you additional points. Find power-ups too!
Explore the Real-World Streets of TorontoThe maps of Trash Panda are created from real-world street data of Canada's most populous city. See if you can visit every street on the map!
Challenges!Some crescents and dead-end streets are home to territorial raccoons that don't want you knocking over their bins. Should you enter these areas, a nemesis raccoon may challenge you to a match! Which of you can knock over the most bins? Winner takes all!
description_short: A small, chill, low-fi raccoon simulator, where you play as a raccoon roaming neighbourhoods of Toronto making a mess. Knock over trash bins, find power-ups, challenge other raccoons, and get lost.
